 Learn more IRVING, Texas (AP) — IRVING, Texas (AP) — Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) on Thursday reported third-quarter profit of $3.29 billion. 
 The Irving, Texas-based company said it had profit of $7.13 per share. Earnings, adjusted for restructuring costs, were $7.20 per share. 
 The results topped Wall Street expectations. The average estimate of 11 analysts surveyed by Zacks Investment Research was for earnings of $7.12 per share. 
 The construction equipment company posted revenue of $20.68 billion in the period, which also beat Street forecasts. Seven analysts surveyed by Zacks expected $20.58 billion.
